withdrawSteps.title: How to Withdraw Cryptocurrency
withdrawSteps.stepTip1: Choose the currency you want to withdraw.
withdrawSteps.stepTip2: External Address: Copy the deposit platform's address and Memo (if necessary) to this platform. Please ensure that the network you select matches the deposit platform's network, otherwise it will cause asset loss.
withdrawSteps.stepTip3: Please confirm the withdrawal amount and fees.
withdrawSteps.stepTip4: After blockchain confirmation, your withdrawal information will be transferred to the deposit platform.

toUpSteps.title: How to Deposit Cryptocurrency
toUpSteps.stepTip1: Select the currency and network you want to deposit. Please ensure that the network you select matches the withdrawal platform's network, otherwise it will cause asset loss.
toUpSteps.stepTip2: Copy the deposit address, or use the scanned deposit QR code, ensure that both networks match; if Memo is required, please fill in the Memo information.
toUpSteps.stepTip3: Check the address on the withdrawal platform and initiate withdrawal.
toUpSteps.stepTip4: After blockchain confirmation, we will deposit the assets directly into the spot account.

toUpSteps.memoTip1: Correctly fill in the address and MEMO to deposit to the account
